title: Granola hero
description: A two-screen editorial hero on white: a pill badge, a huge light serif headline, a short lead and an olive pill on the left; on the right a tall app window pinned in place with art cards fanned behind it and a call strip on its edge. As you scroll the window settles (shrinks from 1.2× and slides in), the art drifts in and fades, the strip rises in parallax, and a second screen of ruled icon rows inside a dashed frame scrolls up beside it.
notes: 200svh tall: two window-height rows beside a pinned column on desktop; on phones the copy, a 125svh pinned track for the window, then the rows
window, call strip and three art cards are media slots; empty, they are plain token surfaces at the original's sizes
all motion is a CSS view timeline on the section; without support, or with reduced motion, the window sits settled and the art stays visible
leaves 56px at the top for a fixed header
